claim_text: A gas-main rupture caused the blast near Alder Quay.

evidence_spans.snippet_text: The county response office said crews were assessing the site; it had not confirmed the cause or reported any damage.

source_webpage.html_content: Residents near Alder Quay reported a loud blast shortly after 06:00. The county response office said crews were assessing the site; it had not confirmed the cause or reported any damage.

verdict_rationale: The webpage confirms reports of a blast but says the response office had not confirmed its cause. It provides no evidence identifying a gas-main rupture.
